name: Kyoto Mejoku Kikou
source:
Our protagonist appears in a certain sightseeing tour in Kyoto. Naturally, his objective isn't just to sightsee...

His real intent, is of course, is to find all the Kyoto women who are prim and proper, innocent and pure, untouched by anyone else... and to make them all his!

Nami Yamashita, his sightseeing tour guide for 2 days and 1 night, Sanae Ichinose the model... 

Can he manage to make these two his sex sl*ves?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ034936.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
